Corollary
[evolution of scalar curvature] Source: cao-zhu 1. Corollary 1.3.3\group Cao–Zhu Evolution of Curvatures \[ \partial _tR=\Delta R+2|\Ric |^2. \]
Proof

\sketch Trace the Ricci evolution equation and use $\partial _tg^{ij}=2R^{ij}$.

□

Choose an evolving orthonormal frame $F_a=F_a^i\partial _i$ with $\partial _tF_a^i=g^{ij}R_{jk}F_a^k$. In this frame the curvature operator is the symmetric form on $\Lambda ^2$ determined by \[ R_{abcd}=M_{\alpha \beta }\varphi _{ab}^\alpha \varphi _{cd}^\beta , \qquad [\varphi ^\alpha ,\varphi ^\beta ]=C^{\alpha \beta }_\gamma \varphi ^\gamma . \]
